headline: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña Resigns Amid Financial Scandal and Arrest Order
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña resigned following a financial scandal involving a local bank, after which the Senate rejected his request for additional time and an arrest warrant was issued.
why: Political crises and the sudden departure of a head of state can trigger sovereign risk re-evaluations and currency volatility in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Presidential resignation and arrest warrants increase political instability and sovereign risk.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The unexpected resignation and subsequent legal action against the president fueled political uncertainty and market concerns.
